sources.title: The BagIt File Packaging Format (V1.0)
sources.access_utc: UNKNOWN exact request time; reviewed during read-only browser session ending 2026-10-10T04:29:27Z
sources.observed_operation: Opened official RFC and inspected package scope, manifests/completeness, tag semantics, algorithms, and path interoperability; no product/validator run.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: BagIt 1.0 tools MUST support SHA-256 and SHA-512 and SHOULD enable SHA-512 by default. Manifests list payload files; completeness and checksum validity are distinct. bag-info.txt is optional human-use metadata; arbitrary tags are allowed but unrecognized semantics are ignored. Filename normalization differs across systems/tools.
sources.applicability: Supports per-deposit packaging and path/integrity checks; does not define gallery intent or a native corrected-version history model.

sources.title: Oxford Common File Layout Specification
sources.released_version_or_commit: OCFL 1.1 specification family; 1.1.1 tag c3f88b3; 1.1 release tag 1.1 / commit 4b05472
sources.access_utc: UNKNOWN exact request time; reviewed by 2026-10-10T04:29:27Z
sources.observed_operation: Opened official spec and checked version directories, manifest scope, inventories and sidecars; no validator/implementation run.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Objects use continuous version directories; each version's content files must appear in its inventory manifest. Every inventory file has a required digest sidecar; version-directory inventories SHOULD be included, while the root inventory MUST exist.
sources.applicability: Native filesystem object version history; full-object copy is an operational inference and validation remains necessary.
